title: Savings & Copay Assistance Programs: Deductible Left Out of the Manufacturer Copay Card Benefit Base
content:
The benefit base of a Manufacturer Copay Card counter benefit of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs — the part of the claim's patient pay the counter benefit is worked on — leaves out part of the deductible the plan applied on the claim, according to the linked plan.

| Linked plan (Prescription Insurance on File) | Benefit base |
|---|---|
| Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan | the patient pay less half (50 percent) of the claim's deductible portion |
| Commercial Copay Plan | the patient pay less the whole deductible portion |
| Any other plan | the whole patient pay |

The claim is the latest paid insurance claim of the card's prescription; its patient pay and its deductible portion are those recorded on that claim.

**Hypothetical claim with a patient pay of $1800.00 of which $1200.00 is deductible.** Commercial High-Deductible Health Plan: base $1200.00. Commercial Copay Plan: base $600.00. Any other plan: base $1800.00.
